name: Form Grading

business_logic: 1. Load draft grading_record by id (route param) beserta seluruh grading_detail turunannya ke form state
2. Auto-set Tanggal (date) = waktu saat ini HANYA jika draft baru (date masih kosong); jika draft dilanjutkan (sudah punya nilai), pertahankan nilai date tersimpan, tidak ditimpa

3. Load daftar Weighbridge lokal (SEMUA record, status apapun, urut arrival_datetime terbaru dulu) untuk dropdown WB Card No; load daftar Grading Parameter (urut sort_order) untuk dropdown Quality Parameter tiap baris

4. On pilih WB Card No: auto-isi license_plate_no dari weighbridge_record.vehicle_number, estate_supplier dari weighbridge_record.estate_supplier, division dari weighbridge_record.division; ketiga field tetap dapat diedit manual setelahnya, TIDAK ditimpa ulang otomatis lagi setelah auto-fill awal (hanya terjadi sekali saat WB Card No dipilih)
5. On pilih Quality Parameter di suatu baris Grading Detail: uom baris di-set (snapshot, bukan live-join) dari grading_parameter.uom yang dipilih, field UOM disabled/read-only

6. Opsi dropdown Quality Parameter PER BARIS = seluruh grading_parameter DIKURANGI parameter yang sudah dipilih di baris LAIN pada grid yang sama (baris itu sendiri tetap menampilkan parameter yang sedang dipilihnya sebagai opsi, agar tetap terlihat/tidak hilang dari dropdown-nya sendiri) — daftar opsi ini dihitung ulang (reaktif) setiap kali baris manapun menambah/mengubah/menghapus pilihan Quality Parameter-nya, termasuk saat baris ditambah atau dihapus

7. Percentage tiap baris dihitung reaktif: qty/netto_header*100 jika uom baris='kg', qty/quantity_header*100 jika uom baris='bunch' — dihitung ulang setiap kali qty baris ITU SENDIRI berubah, atau netto/quantity header berubah (mempengaruhi SEMUA baris)

8. Render field dikelompokkan per section: Identitas Grading (Grading No, Tanggal), Referensi Weighbridge & Kendaraan (WB Card No, License Plate No, Vehicle Code), Asal Muatan (Estate, Divisi), Data Berat & Kuantitas (Netto (kg), Quantity (bunch), Note), Grading Detail (grid tambah/hapus baris)
9. Render breadcrumb (Home > Production Process Activity > Grading > Form, tappable) dan header dengan hamburger
10. On Tambah baris Grading Detail: tambah 1 baris kosong baru (tanpa id) ke grid

11. On Hapus baris Grading Detail: hapus baris dari form state; jika baris punya id (sudah tersimpan sebelumnya), tandai untuk DELETE saat Simpan berikutnya; Quality Parameter yang dipakai baris tersebut otomatis kembali tersedia di dropdown baris lain (langkah 6 dihitung ulang)

12. On Simpan: validasi field wajib (Grading No, WB Card No terpilih, Vehicle Code, Estate, Netto, Quantity) dan minimal 1 baris Grading Detail dengan Quality Parameter+Qty terisi → jika lengkap: UPDATE grading_record (semua field header, status=saved) → upsert grading_detail (baris tanpa id: INSERT baru; baris dengan id: UPDATE; baris yang ditandai dihapus: DELETE) → navigasi ke Monitor Grading
13. On Pause: UPDATE grading_record (field form apa adanya, status=draft_paused, TANPA validasi field wajib), grading_detail rows di-upsert apa adanya juga → navigasi ke Monitor Grading
14. On Clear: tampilkan dialog konfirmasi → jika dikonfirmasi: DELETE seluruh grading_detail milik record lalu DELETE grading_record → navigasi ke Monitor; jika dibatalkan: tidak ada perubahan
15. On Back: jika form dirty: tampilkan dialog konfirmasi → jika dikonfirmasi, buang perubahan di memori, navigasi ke Monitor; jika tidak dirty, navigasi langsung
16. On tap breadcrumb segment → navigasi ke route terkait
17. On tap hamburger → buka menu navigasi (Ganti Password, Logout)

data_operations.description: SELECT record by id untuk load form state
SELECT semua record lokal (status apapun) untuk populate dropdown WB Card No
SELECT semua parameter urut sort_order untuk populate dropdown Quality Parameter
UPDATE semua field header + status=saved pada Simpan, atau field apa adanya + status=draft_paused pada Pause
INSERT baris baru (tanpa id sebelumnya) pada Simpan/Pause
UPDATE baris yang sudah punya id pada Simpan/Pause
DELETE baris yang dihapus user dari grid, pada Simpan/Pause berikutnya; atau seluruh baris pada Clear
DELETE record pada Clear yang dikonfirmasi

edge_case_handling.condition: Field wajib belum lengkap saat Simpan
edge_case_handling.handling: Tampilkan error inline per field, record tidak tersimpan

edge_case_handling.condition: Belum ada baris Grading Detail valid (Quality Parameter+Qty terisi) saat Simpan
edge_case_handling.handling: Tampilkan pesan error khusus, record tidak tersimpan

edge_case_handling.condition: Belum ada data Weighbridge lokal sama sekali
edge_case_handling.handling: Dropdown WB Card No kosong/menampilkan opsi 'Tidak ada data Weighbridge'

edge_case_handling.condition: User mengedit License Plate No/Estate/Divisi manual setelah auto-fill
edge_case_handling.handling: Nilai manual dipertahankan, tidak ditimpa ulang oleh sistem selama sesi form ini

edge_case_handling.condition: User membuka dropdown Quality Parameter pada suatu baris ketika parameter lain sudah dipakai di baris lain
edge_case_handling.handling: Parameter yang sudah dipakai di baris LAIN disembunyikan dari daftar opsi; parameter yang sedang dipilih baris ITU SENDIRI tetap tampil sebagai opsi

edge_case_handling.condition: Baris yang memakai suatu Quality Parameter dihapus, atau parameternya diganti ke parameter lain
edge_case_handling.handling: Parameter yang sebelumnya terpakai otomatis kembali tersedia sebagai opsi di dropdown baris-baris lain

edge_case_handling.condition: User menghapus baris Grading Detail yang sudah ada (punya id)
edge_case_handling.handling: Baris hilang dari grid; ditandai untuk DELETE eksplisit dari grading_detail saat Simpan/Pause berikutnya
Field form + grid Grading Detail terisi dari draft tersimpan, opsi dropdown tiap baris otomatis mengecualikan parameter yang sudah terpakai di baris lain sejak awal render
Tampilkan dialog konfirmasi wajib sebelum DELETE dieksekusi

business_rules_applied: WB Card No wajib dipilih dari dropdown, bukan teks bebas
License Plate No/Estate/Divisi auto-terisi dari Weighbridge, tetap dapat diedit manual
Minimal satu baris Grading Detail sebelum Simpan
Setiap Quality Parameter hanya dapat dipakai di satu baris, tidak muncul lagi di dropdown baris lain setelah dipilih
UOM tiap baris snapshot dari Quality Parameter yang dipilih, tidak dapat diedit manual
Percentage dihitung otomatis berdasarkan uom baris (kg terhadap Netto, bunch terhadap Quantity)
Tanggal otomatis sekali saat draft baru dibuat
Checked By tidak ditampilkan pada form ini

unit_test_cases.description: sets date to current time when draft is new (date empty)
unit_test_cases.given: loaded draft record has date = null/empty
unit_test_cases.expect: date set to current timestamp (now) exactly once on mount

unit_test_cases.description: preserves stored date when resuming a paused draft
unit_test_cases.given: loaded draft record has date = '2026-08-18T08:00:00' (already set)
unit_test_cases.expect: date remains '2026-08-18T08:00:00', not overwritten

unit_test_cases.description: populates WB Card No dropdown from all local weighbridge_record rows regardless of status
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridgeRepo returns 3 records with mixed statuses (saved, draft_ongoing, synced)
unit_test_cases.expect: dropdown options include all 3 records, ordered by arrival_datetime descending

unit_test_cases.description: shows empty/placeholder option when no local weighbridge_record exists
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridgeRepo returns []
unit_test_cases.expect: dropdown renders empty state, WB Card No field has no selectable options

unit_test_cases.description: auto-fills license_plate_no, estate_supplier, division from the selected weighbridge_record
unit_test_cases.given: user selects a WB Card No option corresponding to a weighbridge_record with vehicle_number='B 1234 XYZ', estate_supplier='Estate A', division='Divisi 2'
unit_test_cases.expect: form fields license_plate_no='B 1234 XYZ', estate_supplier='Estate A', division='Divisi 2' set

unit_test_cases.description: does not re-overwrite manually edited auto-filled fields on subsequent renders
unit_test_cases.given: WB Card No already selected and auto-fill applied, user then manually changes estate_supplier to a different value
unit_test_cases.expect: estate_supplier retains the manually-edited value, not reset back to the weighbridge_record's original value

unit_test_cases.description: sets detail row uom from the selected grading_parameter as a snapshot
unit_test_cases.given: user selects Quality Parameter with uom='bunch' for a detail row
unit_test_cases.expect: that row's uom field set to 'bunch', disabled/read-only

unit_test_cases.description: excludes a Quality Parameter already selected in another row from that row's own dropdown options
unit_test_cases.given: row 1 has grading_parameter_id='gp-003' selected; computing available options for row 2
unit_test_cases.expect: row 2's available options list does NOT include 'gp-003'

unit_test_cases.description: still includes a row's own currently selected Quality Parameter in its own dropdown options
unit_test_cases.given: row 1 has grading_parameter_id='gp-003' selected; computing available options for row 1 itself
unit_test_cases.expect: row 1's available options list DOES include 'gp-003'

unit_test_cases.description: returns a Quality Parameter to other rows' available options once the row that had it selected is removed
unit_test_cases.given: row 1 selected 'gp-003' (excluded from row 2's options), row 1 is then removed via Hapus baris
unit_test_cases.expect: row 2's available options list now includes 'gp-003' again

unit_test_cases.description: returns a Quality Parameter to other rows' available options once the row's selection is changed to a different parameter
unit_test_cases.given: row 1 changes its selection from 'gp-003' to 'gp-005'
unit_test_cases.expect: 'gp-003' becomes available again in other rows' options; 'gp-005' becomes excluded from other rows' options

unit_test_cases.description: computes percentage using netto when the row's uom is kg
unit_test_cases.given: header netto=1000, detail row uom='kg', qty=250
unit_test_cases.expect: row percentage = 25

unit_test_cases.description: computes percentage using quantity when the row's uom is bunch
unit_test_cases.given: header quantity=120, detail row uom='bunch', qty=30
unit_test_cases.expect: row percentage = 25

unit_test_cases.description: recomputes a row's percentage when that row's qty changes
unit_test_cases.given: row uom='kg', header netto=1000, qty changes from 100 to 200
unit_test_cases.expect: percentage recalculated from 10 to 20

unit_test_cases.description: recomputes all rows' percentages when header netto or quantity changes
unit_test_cases.given: 2 detail rows, one uom='kg' one uom='bunch', header netto changes from 1000 to 2000
unit_test_cases.expect: the kg-uom row's percentage recalculated using new netto; the bunch-uom row's percentage unaffected by netto change

unit_test_cases.description: adds a new empty detail row when 'Tambah baris' is triggered
unit_test_cases.given: grid currently has 1 row
unit_test_cases.expect: grid has 2 rows after add, new row has no id, empty quality parameter and qty

unit_test_cases.description: removes a detail row from form state when 'Hapus baris' is triggered on a row without an id
unit_test_cases.given: a newly-added row (no id) is removed
unit_test_cases.expect: row removed from form state; no DELETE recorded for save time (never existed in DB)

unit_test_cases.description: marks an existing detail row for deletion when 'Hapus baris' is triggered on a row with an id
unit_test_cases.given: a row loaded from an existing draft (has id) is removed
unit_test_cases.expect: row removed from grid display; its id recorded in a pending-deletion list for the next Simpan/Pause

unit_test_cases.description: returns validation errors and does not save when required header fields are incomplete on Simpan
unit_test_cases.given: WB Card No not selected, Simpan triggered
unit_test_cases.expect: validation fails, inline error returned, gradingRepo.saveDraft() not called

unit_test_cases.description: returns validation error and does not save when no valid detail rows exist on Simpan
unit_test_cases.given: all detail rows lack Quality Parameter or Qty, Simpan triggered
unit_test_cases.expect: validation fails with detail-specific error, gradingRepo.saveDraft() not called

unit_test_cases.description: saves record with status=saved, upserting new and updated rows, and deleting removed rows, when all required data is complete on Simpan
unit_test_cases.given: all required header fields filled, 2 valid detail rows (1 new, 1 existing edited), 1 row marked for deletion, Simpan triggered
unit_test_cases.expect: gradingRepo.saveDraft() called with header data, status='saved', the 2 upserted rows, and the 1 pending deletion id; navigation to Monitor Grading triggered

unit_test_cases.description: updates record with status=draft_paused without validating required fields on Pause
unit_test_cases.given: required field is empty, Pause triggered
unit_test_cases.expect: gradingRepo update called with current field values as-is, status='draft_paused', no validation errors; navigation to Monitor Grading triggered

unit_test_cases.description: shows confirmation dialog before deleting on Clear
unit_test_cases.given: Clear button pressed
unit_test_cases.expect: confirmation dialog displayed; delete not yet called

unit_test_cases.description: deletes record and all its detail rows, then navigates to Monitor when Clear is confirmed
unit_test_cases.given: Clear confirmation dialog confirmed
unit_test_cases.expect: grading_detail rows deleted, grading_record deleted; navigation to Monitor Grading triggered

unit_test_cases.description: does not delete record when Clear confirmation is cancelled
unit_test_cases.given: Clear confirmation dialog cancelled
unit_test_cases.expect: delete not called; form state unchanged

unit_test_cases.description: shows confirmation dialog on Back when form is dirty
unit_test_cases.given: form state isDirty = true, Back pressed
unit_test_cases.expect: confirmation dialog displayed before navigation

unit_test_cases.description: navigates directly on Back when form is not dirty
unit_test_cases.given: form state isDirty = false, Back pressed
unit_test_cases.expect: navigates to Monitor Grading immediately, no dialog shown

unit_test_cases.description: navigates to related route when a breadcrumb segment is tapped
unit_test_cases.given: breadcrumb segment 'Grading' tapped
unit_test_cases.expect: router navigates to the corresponding Monitor Grading route

unit_test_cases.description: opens navigation menu when hamburger icon is tapped
unit_test_cases.given: hamburger icon tapped
unit_test_cases.expect: navigation menu opens showing Ganti Password and Logout options

implementation_notes: Simpan/Pause/Clear bersifat lokal (SQLite); pengiriman ke server terjadi lewat mekanisme sync manual terpisah, di luar scope screen ini

Opsi dropdown Quality Parameter per baris = computed reaktif atas seluruh detailRows.value (bukan hanya properti lokal baris itu) — setiap baris perlu tahu apa yang dipilih baris LAIN, sehingga computed ini harus bereaksi terhadap perubahan grading_parameter_id di baris manapun, bukan cuma baris dirinya sendiri

Cakupan dropdown WB Card No: SEMUA record weighbridge_record lokal apa pun statusnya, urut arrival_datetime terbaru dulu — asumsi agent karena tidak ada instruksi eksplisit user soal filter tanggal/status; jika salah, cukup revisi query-nya tanpa mengubah struktur field lain

Checked By TIDAK diimplementasikan pada form ini sama sekali (kolom checked_by di grading_record tetap ada di skema tapi tidak dibaca/ditulis dari screen ini) — mengikuti mock referensi yang tidak mencantumkannya
Percentage dan UOM tidak pernah diinput manual oleh user — keduanya read-only/computed di UI, hanya qty dan quality_parameter yang benar-benar interaktif per baris
